// @path: src/app/actions/somewhere.ts
// @expect: contains
// Sanitised into a variable one line early, then the variable is what reaches
// the query. This is SAFE code and the gate refuses it anyway, deliberately.
//
// The gate cannot follow a value across a statement, and a rule that pretended
// to would be the hollow kind. So the requirement is that the safety is visible
// AT THE CALL SITE — which is also what a reviewer reading the query needs. The
// fix is to move the call, not to widen the rule.
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { likeSafe } from "@/lib/likeSafe";

export async function searchSchools(query: string) {
  const safe = likeSafe(query);
  return db.establishment.findMany({ where: { name: { contains: safe } } });
}
